output.summary: The recorded sustainer drop ($301k of $520k) lines up with the February migration. 702 profiles were imported without payment methods and the legacy CardVault schedules were never cancelled. The ED's arrival is a coincidence in timing. Moreno left for relocation, no complaint names the ED, and major-donor retention is about the same as the prior year. The Brandt gift explains the major-gift dip. CardVault deposits of $181k may be sustainer gifts or may be corporate pledges and tenant fees, so the recording gap and the number of lapsed sustainers are unresolved. Economic and appeal-letter effects on small gifts are confounded. Do not terminate the ED and do not close CardVault. Get account access and reconcile, sample the pending sustainers before any re-solicitation, and assign the donor calls.
